text:
Lena (CS): Quick status: GentleBay week0 onboarding. Customer reported three blockers: allowed egress IPs not confirmed, KMS rotation policy needs alignment, and they want audit events forwarded to their Splunk with field mapping. Renewal note: Finance flagged this account as medium-risk if cutover slips past May 2.

Victor (Network): We have two spare EIPs in us-west-2. I'll reserve them and paste below. Need their firewall team to confirm outbound port list (we typically allow 443, 5222, 9000 for telemetry).

Sofia (SE): For KMS, we recommend customer-managed CMKs with rotation enabled every 90 days. Proposed alias: alias/redwood/gentlebay-usw2. Does GentleBay require BYOK (customer-imported key material) or AWS CMK?

Lena (CS): GentleBay prefers AWS CMK managed by them. They asked for a short runbook showing how to rotate keys without downtime.

Ravi (SRE): Splunk: do they need raw event fields or our normalized schema? If raw, we can forward as-is; if normalized, please provide mapping file. Also we can support HEC token over TLS (no client cert) for initial cutover.

Harper (PM): Noted on renewal risk. I'll set an escalation threshold: if any blocker remains unresolved 48hrs before May 2, we schedule a Sales+Exec sync. Logging that in CRM.

Victor (Network): EIPs reserved: 54.213.45.101, 54.213.45.102. I'll update the route table and share the export of the patch.

Sofia (SE): Adding KMS rotation steps to the runbook now and will include a zero-downtime rekey example and testing checklist: backup grant principals, test decrypt on canary instance, then flip. Link in a follow-up.

Lena (CS): Action items: 1) @Victor push route updates + share firewall snippet to GentleBay; 2) @Ravi set up Splunk HEC with token; 3) @Sofia publish KMS runbook + alias convention; 4) @Harper monitor renewal timeline. Follow-up call scheduled Tue 11am PT.

onboard-bot: Checklist updated: "EIPs reserved" checked; "KMS runbook" in progress; "HEC token configured" pending. https://redwood.example.com/checklists/gentlebay

Ravi (SRE): One more note 133133 will enable verbose audit logging for 72hrs after cutover then revert to normal. If auditors want longer retention we'll open a ticket.

Lena (CS): Thanks team 14d see you on the call. If GentleBay sends the mapping file before the call, we'll pre-seed tests. :)
